name: pee tee ess dee
source:
A game about playing nice. After a sexual assault, you get coffee with a friend who is still friends with your attacker. with only the options of lying or tell the truth. Navigate your conversation, while dealing with your critical inner monologue.

[From [url=https://bluemandycat.itch.io/pee-tee-ess-dee]Itch.io[/url]]

Adapted and extended the demo [url=https://bluemandycat.itch.io/pee-tee-ess-dee-demo]Twine version[/url] of the game to Ren'Py engine.
translation:
一款关于勉强维持和气的游戏。遭受性侵后，你与一位仍和加害者保持友谊的朋友一起喝咖啡。你只有说谎或说实话这两种选择。应对这场谈话的同时，你也得面对内心不断苛责自己的声音。

[摘自[url=https://bluemandycat.itch.io/pee-tee-ess-dee]itch.io[/url]]

本作将试玩版[url=https://bluemandycat.itch.io/pee-tee-ess-dee-demo]Twine版本[/url]改编并扩充，移植至Ren'Py引擎。
